body:
Looks great to me. I've done some (AI aided) validation of the results to confirm that the registered constants are fully equivalent to the before state.

Local compile test on Linux/GCC for `target=template_release production=yes`:
```
-rwxr-xr-x.  1 akien akien     75.16M Sep 29 21:18 godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64.master
-rwxr-xr-x.  1 akien akien     74.03M Sep 29 21:11 godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64.pr123968
```

So shaving 1.13M off (1.5%)!

Regarding performance, I understand it should only impact registration when starting the engine, so either way it should be negligible. I ran a quick comparison to confirm:

```
$ hyperfine -w 3 -m 10 "time ./index.x86_64 --quit" "time ./index.x86_64pr --quit"
Benchmark 1: time ./index.x86_64 --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):     675.8 ms ±  31.2 ms    [User: 328.9 ms, System: 176.1 ms]
  Range (min … max):   643.2 ms … 738.6 ms    10 runs
 
Benchmark 2: time ./index.x86_64pr --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):     669.2 ms ±  18.1 ms    [User: 331.0 ms, System: 169.9 ms]
  Range (min … max):   649.8 ms … 701.9 ms    10 runs
 
Summary
  time ./index.x86_64pr --quit ran
    1.01 ± 0.05 times faster than time ./index.x86_64 --quit

$ hyperfine -w 5 -m 15 "time ./index.x86_64 --quit" "time ./index.x86_64pr --quit"
Benchmark 1: time ./index.x86_64 --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):     660.1 ms ±  19.5 ms    [User: 332.8 ms, System: 168.5 ms]
  Range (min … max):   618.5 ms … 709.2 ms    15 runs
 
Benchmark 2: time ./index.x86_64pr --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):     667.9 ms ±  22.5 ms    [User: 336.0 ms, System: 167.6 ms]
  Range (min … max):   621.0 ms … 708.6 ms    15 runs
 
Summary
  time ./index.x86_64 --quit ran
    1.01 ± 0.05 times faster than time ./index.x86_64pr --quit
```

Both within margin of error IMO, no evidence of performance change.
